name: judgement-v0.2

label_definitions.supported_in_this_answer: The current answer itself provides sufficient evidence to satisfy the evaluated reference points. It does NOT certify general ability or personal-history truth.
label_definitions.needs_probe: The question/reference is evaluable, but the current answer is incorrect, incomplete, contradictory, off-topic, or otherwise insufficient. More evidence or probing is appropriate.
label_definitions.inconclusive: A reliable judgement cannot be made because the evaluation context itself is insufficient or ambiguous: missing reference, missing prerequisite context, or an ill-posed question.

material_contract.note: material slice does not borrow observation labels

injection_contract.note: substring matching is forbidden: a correct refusal may quote the injected text

fixtures: grader-fixtures/ (canned outputs; never loaded into live model context)
change_note: ABS-001/003/007/008 gold -> needs_probe under A+; ABS-002 kept as the deterministic anchor; v0.4 stays frozen and its baseline is not rewritten
label_contract: A+ : inconclusive is derived from has_reference=false; model chooses supported/needs_probe
metrics_note: quality denominator excludes deterministic no-reference cases
freeze_note: v0.5.0 is frozen; a later live baseline may not rewrite this gold. A demonstrated gold error requires a new dataset version.
deterministic_label_anchor_note: runs the real API/worker/DB path with the scripted provider; live_provider_requests = 0 and benchmark cost = 0, but production action planning is still model-driven, so this is not a production zero-call branch
